psychological_meaning: Reef Gold evokes a sense of understated luxury and natural beauty. It combines the richness of gold with the grounding influence of earthy tones, creating a feeling of sophistication, maturity, and connection to the environment. This color often suggests stability, timelessness, and a subtle confidence.
